title: Ensure first playable turn always has a persisted scene log
description: Review finding from loreweaver-1ek. First-turn scene persistence depends on the model choosing to call mark_scene; if it narrates without opening a scene, a successful turn can have no player/DM scene transcript. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: A new session's first successful turn persists player and DM lines even if the model does not explicitly open a scene; tests cover successful narration without mark_scene.
